title: Count Good Numbers
goal: Count length-n digit strings with even digits at even indices and prime digits at odd indices.
strategy: There are five even choices and four prime choices. Compute their powers modulo 1000000007 by repeatedly squaring, so huge lengths need only logarithmic work.
